claims.title: Conceptual artifact and scope
claims.permitted_wording: 80 concepts; 77 typed-core plus one separate local anchor in OWL; 134 associations/bridges with 127 core object properties; 25 interpretation constraints.
claims.excluded_wording: Risk knowledge representation, not a risk process or improved decisions; full native language/semantic certification not claimed.

claims.title: Native exchange and OWL projection
claims.permitted_wording: Source-bound schema/SDK exchange and reviewed bounded OWL export.
claims.excluded_wording: Exchange/round-trip validation is not full OntoUML language validation or native-editor import; optional boundaries/bridges stay excluded.

claims.title: Reasoner evidence
claims.permitted_wording: 693 matching executed cases; 281 PASS and 14 NOT_RUN obligations out of 295.
claims.excluded_wording: Finite bounded OWL consequences, not ontology-wide semantic correctness or a fresh HermiT run by this preparation.

claims.title: Explicit-data evidence
claims.permitted_wording: Historical ledger: 341 scoped PASS, one PARTIAL, 17 NOT_RUN out of 359. Later C-08/C-13/C-18 supplements have their own exact cohorts.
claims.excluded_wording: No rewritten historical denominator or arbitrary full risk-record admission; scenarios, preflight rejects and actual engine runs remain separate.

claims.title: Relational implementation
claims.permitted_wording: 67 matched scenario outcomes on selected public SQLite profile 0.1.0, including populated migration, immutability and history.
claims.excluded_wording: Private 128-table schema/859 old checks are not fresh public-model execution; PostgreSQL, formulas, workloads and full InformationContent mapping unclaimed.

claims.title: Requirements and queries
claims.permitted_wording: 28 trace identities; old 40 synthetic executions remain 32 answers plus eight mutants. Current CQ06 and CQ07/08 supplements separately bind finite primary-source cohorts.
claims.excluded_wording: Trace accounting and successful query/control outcomes are not full original requirement/source-population acceptance or independent validation.

claims.title: Reference alignment
claims.permitted_wording: 11 selected sources, 13 inspected-portion interpretation rows and explicit limits.
claims.excluded_wording: No full normative crosswalk/compliance, exhaustive literature search or head-to-head superiority claim.

claims.title: Pharmaceutical demonstration
claims.permitted_wording: Historical dataset/application numbers retain their archived source/version; current source-backed supplements separately inspect 13 statements, five cell pairs and 11 withheld candidates.
claims.excluded_wording: No independently validated RiskCases, incidents, complete extraction accuracy, held-out generalization, clinical probability recomputation or organizational benefit.

claims.title: Design structure and metrics
claims.permitted_wording: Bounded graph connectivity/count observations and original source-bound qualitative design review.
claims.excluded_wording: No full semantic COH/COP, unsupported historical equations or overall domain/ontology quality ranking.

claims.title: Human review
claims.permitted_wording: Prepared 11-row owner/author review cohort with assistant evidence and counterexamples.
claims.excluded_wording: No owner rating yet; independent review #23 remains future and nonblocking, with no independent semantic-acceptance claim.

claims.title: Reproduction/publication/rights
claims.permitted_wording: Rc.1–rc.7 development publication/provenance is recorded, scientific/code rights declared; final candidate still pending.
claims.excluded_wording: Prerelease publication/readback is not final freeze or independent replication; private article/database bytes remain separate.

claims.title: Deferred operational and future scope
claims.permitted_wording: Retain conceptual commitments while explicitly narrowing current executable task claims for review.
claims.excluded_wording: No current computed-score engine, full temporal/workflow authority/admission, transformations, full private-schema migration, future extensions or universal standards compliance.

source_clause.title: Risk Case is not ISO Risk
source_clause.statement: Case identity is preserved across descriptions, scores, owners and administrative states. Equal labels do not establish case identity.

constraints.retained_claim: Separate case, entry and revision keys; labels do not merge identities.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Actual organizational case grounding and real reassessment continuity require attributable evidence; no automatic identity adjudication.

source_clause.title: No realization from description
source_clause.statement: A scenario, consequence statement, signal, plan or report alone must not create actual occurrences, outcomes, controls or effectiveness assertions.

constraints.retained_claim: Documentary scenarios/source statements do not automatically assert actual occurrence or effect.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: No claim that every external inference/application obeys the boundary or that a missing graph assertion proves nonoccurrence.

source_clause.title: Issued version immutability
source_clause.statement: Issued semantic content and effective dependency versions are immutable. Correction and supersession create lineage-preserving new versions.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Not applicable to change prevention: monotonic axioms do not enforce immutability across transactions. Remaining route: Partial: check version links and required snapshot references within one graph. Application history test: change an issued payload, reject overwrite and create a new version with lineage.

constraints.retained_claim: Executed SQLite profile 0.1.0 preserves sealed payload, provenance and version-owned dependency snapshots, creates new revisions and rejects specified mutations.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: No general native InformationContent/RX-007 admission, PostgreSQL/full private-schema migration or protection against administrative DDL/PRAGMA bypass.

source_clause.title: Assessment interpretation
source_clause.statement: Results retain method/scale version, dimension, basis, relevant context and time semantics. A score is not the risk, and estimated likelihood need not be numeric.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: map result types and reference links without reducing risk to a number. Remaining route: Partial: task-ready shapes require task-specific pinned method, scale, dimension, basis and time. Review measurement interpretation and qualitative likelihood; scalar fields still need an approved schema.

constraints.retained_claim: Selected comparison records require pinned interpretation metadata and matching declared context; equal score labels/numbers cannot authorize that named task.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Not universal assessment readiness, full temporal semantics, all qualitative likelihood interpretations or reproduced version-specific method payload permissions.

source_clause.title: Temporal and administrative distinction
source_clause.statement: Recorded time, reference time and validity intervals are distinct. Workflow closure does not prove risk cessation or successful treatment.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: test that administrative state does not entail cessation or effectiveness. Remaining route: Partial: check distinct temporal fields and interval ordering after the datatype schema is approved. Application and semantic review define time zones, unknown endpoints and cessation evidence.

constraints.retained_claim: Recorded/reference/validity time and administrative versus real-world status remain distinct design commitments; synthetic retrieval illustrates closure versus cessation.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Interval ordering, timezone/unknown-endpoint policy, actual cessation and treatment-effectiveness adjudication or workflow execution are not implemented/accepted claims.

source_clause.title: Relator participant distinctness
source_clause.statement: An asserted ResponsibilityRelator requires at least two distinct mediated individuals. If bearer and authority resolve to one actor and no further grounding exists, retain ResponsibilityAssignmentInformation without asserting the relator.

constraints.retained_claim: Bounded OWL and explicit-data tests enforce declared participant distinctness and retain assignment information when no relator can be grounded.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Explicit identity evidence is required; different names alone do not prove different individuals or actual mandate truth.

source_clause.title: Role-qualified ownership
source_clause.statement: ResponsibleAgentRole does not automatically mean Risk Owner. Ownership mapping requires recorded responsibility type, accountability, authority and applicable context.

constraints.retained_claim: A responsibility role/assignment record is not automatically an actual mandate or Risk Owner.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Automatic source-to-owner mapping with validated accountability/authority/scope is deferred; no automatic Risk Owner population.

source_clause.title: Threshold anchor
source_clause.statement: At least one of thresholdForIndicator or thresholdOnScale is present. If both are present, their scale/unit interpretation is compatible. Qualitative boundaries use scale semantics rather than invented numeric units.

HermiT.case_id: H-C08-ANCHOR-UNION, H-C08-REMOVED-UNION, H-C08-SCALE-ONLY, H-C08-ANONYMOUS-ANCHOR, H-C08-DUAL-ANCHOR, H-C08-NO-FABRICATED-INDICATOR

constraints.retained_claim: Profile 0.6.0 checks declared numeric/qualitative metadata compatibility for its caller-selected dual-anchor threshold task.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Global C-08 remains PARTIAL; no unit conversion, broad dimensional adequacy, numeric evaluation or full risk-record admission.

source_clause.title: Description aboutness
source_clause.statement: Every published RiskDescription has at least one case, pattern or scenario target. Multiple valid targets are permitted and require explicit interpretation.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: an existential aboutness disjunction may be mapped, but publication completeness is a graph policy. Remaining route: Planned: Core alternativePath over describesCase, describesPattern and expressesScenario with minCount 1. Select the published-description profile and document multiple-target interpretation.

constraints.retained_claim: Published-description SHACL checks explicit case/pattern/scenario aboutness and permits multiple declared targets.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Not HermiT discharge, target truth, occurrence evidence or a single universal target interpretation.

source_clause.title: Framework-qualified tolerance
source_clause.statement: Tolerance statements retain source framework/version, original meaning and context. Permissible deviation is not automatically equivalent to readiness to bear remaining risk.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: preserve separate statement resources without asserting a global equivalence of tolerance meanings. Remaining route: Partial: require source framework/version and context once provenance properties are approved. Review source-specific meanings and inspected source portions.

constraints.retained_claim: Distinct source-qualified tolerance meanings are represented without global equivalence.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Complete normative appetite/tolerance definitions and ISO/COBIT/Risk IT equivalence/crosswalk/compliance are unassessed and unclaimed.

source_clause.title: Vocabulary resource identity
source_clause.statement: Vocabulary resources retain scheme-qualified identity. Labels are representations and are not OWL classes by default.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: vocabulary individuals are not generated as OWL classes or equality axioms from labels. Remaining route: Planned: scheme membership, resource identity and label-data validation using an approved vocabulary profile. Review scheme identifiers and legitimate cross-scheme mappings.

constraints.retained_claim: Vocabulary metadata is keyed by scheme/edition/code; label equality does not create classes or cross-scheme identity.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Metadata key validation is not universal ontological identity adjudication or a HermiT PASS for this clause.

source_clause.title: Evidence does not endorse
source_clause.statement: EvidenceReference states an evidential role such as support, challenge or context. Linking a source does not automatically prove the target claim.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: evidential links alone must not entail truth or endorsement of the target claim. Remaining route: Partial: require support/challenge/context qualification and source locators after the assertion schema is reviewed. Review evidential adequacy independently of presence or graph conformance.

constraints.retained_claim: Selected evidence records carry source/item/target and Support/Challenge/Context role; source-query provenance can be inspected.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Conformance and source links do not establish truth, endorsement, evidential adequacy or independent corroboration.

source_clause.title: Scale and dimension compatibility
source_clause.statement: A selected level belongs to the selected scale version and dimension. Results on incompatible methods/scales are not ranked merely by equal labels or numeric codes.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: typed relationships can be represented; arbitrary joins across scale/version/dimension are not assumed expressible. Remaining route: Planned: SPARQL checks selected level, scale version and dimension against pinned interpretation. Review unit conversion, dimensions and missing-version policy.

constraints.retained_claim: Profile 0.7.0 checks selected level/scale-version/dimension joins for the declared comparison task.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: No general level ordering, numeric-code ranking, unit transformation or proof of scale meaning.

source_clause.title: Heterogeneous boundaries
source_clause.statement: RiskSource, Consequence and RiskControl remain catalog notions and optional external boundaries, excluded from native formal-core class assertions. Source, outcome and control content is represented by RiskSourceReference, ConsequenceStatement and ControlReference.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Planned: reject typed-core declarations for the three excluded catalog boundaries in the export. Remaining route: Planned: boundary-admission checks reject using those catalog notions as managed core classes. Record optional external bridges separately; adding an external ontology requires a new ownership decision.

constraints.retained_claim: Three optional heterogeneous boundaries and seven bridges are excluded from the typed core; documentary reference classes remain.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Structural/boundary checks are not new HermiT runs or proof of external referent existence; external ontology import/mapping extension stays future work.

source_clause.title: Intrinsic vulnerability bearer
source_clause.statement: Every asserted intrinsic Vulnerability has exactly one substantial-endurant bearer. A reported hypothesis alone is information, not an actual mode.

constraints.retained_claim: Bounded OWL bearer dependence/cardinality supports the intrinsic-vulnerability design; reports remain documentary information.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Full explicit-data bearer admission and real-world substantial-bearer/vulnerability grounding remain unexecuted/unaccepted; no automatic mode from a hypothesis.

source_clause.title: Admission profiles
source_clause.statement: Raw source content is retained in staging. Managed records require identity, subject, title and provenance. Analytical readiness additionally requires the pinned context, method, scale, basis, dimension and time required for the selected task.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Not applicable to explicit-data completeness: OWL inference is not a record-admission decision. Remaining route: Planned: separate raw, managed and task-ready shapes; never run a managed requirement as raw rejection. Approve required identity, title and provenance properties and task-specific input sets.

constraints.retained_claim: CatalogInspection metadata admission and separately named compatibility/comparison/source/history tasks have explicit staging and task boundaries.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: No general complete RiskAssessment readiness or arbitrary multi-relation/conditional integration; only named executed profiles may be called supported.

source_clause.title: Multiple assertions
source_clause.statement: Multiple classifications, descriptions, actors and evidence assertions are retained with role, context, provenance and time. Scalar export requires an explicit selection rule when several values apply.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: multiple assertions must remain consistent without unsupported functional properties or identity keys. Remaining route: Partial: check qualified assertion context, time and provenance after schema review. Application export test: multiple applicable values require a declared scalar selection rule.

constraints.retained_claim: Selected source-query/SQL fixtures retain conflicting assertions, original/reissued values and provenance without silently selecting or overwriting.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: A universal scalar-export selection policy across all contexts/times and complete multi-assertion admission is deferred.

source_clause.title: Comparable assessments
source_clause.statement: Direct comparison requires matching pinned method, scale, dimension, basis and temporal context; a governed explicit transformation may enable a different comparison. Missing data is not zero. Reported scores do not imply a reproducible computation.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: test absence of comparability entailments from equal numbers or labels. Remaining route: Planned: SPARQL task-readiness joins over pinned method, scale, dimension, basis and temporal context. Application calculation/comparison tests cover governed transformations and missing values.

constraints.retained_claim: Profile 0.7.0 checks strict eligibility for direct comparison of two selected pairs under declared pinned interpretation; missing data is not zero.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Governed transformations, ranking/calculation, general temporal interpretation and universal assessment comparability are not claimed.

source_clause.title: Workflow semantics
source_clause.statement: State labels are scheme/version qualified. Transition rules and authority are source-backed content. Missing rule means UNKNOWN; Closed does not imply ceased risk and Treated does not imply effectiveness.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: scheme-qualified workflow state does not entail actual risk cessation or effectiveness. Remaining route: Partial: validate scheme/version references and source-backed transition-rule records. Application transition tests enforce authority; absent rules yield UNKNOWN, not automatic permission.

constraints.retained_claim: Workflow labels/rules/authority remain source-qualified design content; Closed/Treated alone cannot establish cessation/effectiveness.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: No executable transition authority engine, universal workflow scheme mapping or treatment-effectiveness acceptance is claimed.

source_clause.title: Risk Item vocabulary
source_clause.statement: In the terminology adopted by this profile, Risk Item denotes the managed risk subject modeled as RiskCase. This context-qualified mapping does not equate RiskCase with RiskRegisterEntry, RiskScenarioSpecification, ISO risk or any global Risk Item class.

constraints.retained_claim: Risk Item is a local terminology convention for the managed RiskCase subject, distinct from entry/scenario/ISO risk.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: No global Risk Item equivalence, automatic label-based import/class alignment or universal terminology standard.

source_clause.title: Reported and computed scores
source_clause.statement: A reported RiskScoreResult may have no derivedFrom links. A computed RiskScoreResult requires at least one linked DimensionAssessmentResult, a pinned method and adequate inputs. The score kind must be recorded.

HermiT.reason: Current OWL route: Partial: represent result and input relationships without treating a missing triple as proof of inconsistency. Remaining route: Planned: conditional reported/computed shapes require derivedFrom, pinned method and adequate inputs for computed results. Application tests rerun the formula; score-kind and formula/input scalar schema still need review.

constraints.retained_claim: Reported and computed score meanings/links are distinguished in the conceptual design.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Complete current conditional computed-score admission, formula/input scalar schema and reproducible arithmetic engine are not executed public capabilities. Historical private calculation checks remain historical.

source_clause.title: Responsibility identity
source_clause.statement: Repeated mandates between the same participants are permitted when grounding assignment, responsibility scope or validity differs. Duplicate representations of the same grounded mandate must resolve to one relator identity; participant equality alone is not an identity key.

constraints.retained_claim: Bounded OWL countermodels avoid using participant pair alone as a mandate identity key.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Actual assignment/scope/validity grounding and application deduplication of mandates are deferred; no new actual responsibility identities from names.

source_clause.title: Context relation coherence
source_clause.statement: Every analyzedInContext link is also a hasContext link for the same RiskCase and RiskContextSpecification. The broader hasContext relation may include non-analysis context.

constraints.retained_claim: Current explicit graph coherence checks analyzedInContext as a subrelation of hasContext with the same pair; no reverse repair.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Finite asserted-graph constraint checks, not all data or full task/semantic acceptance.

source_clause.title: Revision coherence
source_clause.statement: For each EntryRevision, revisionOf and inherited versionOf identify the same RiskRegisterEntry. previousRevision is irreflexive and acyclic and, when present, relates revisions of the same entry.

constraints.retained_claim: Current graph coherence and SQLite history enforce selected same-entry revision/version targets and predecessor-cycle rules, including branches and tested long chains.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: Static graph evidence alone is not history; SQLite history is limited to declared profile and configured connection, not universal storage certification.

source_clause.title: Version target coherence
source_clause.statement: usesContextVersion targets a version of RiskContextSpecification; usesMethodVersion a version of AssessmentMethodSpecification; usesScaleVersion a version of AssessmentScale; usesCriteriaVersion a version of RiskCriteria. Artifact-level references, when present, agree with versionOf.

constraints.retained_claim: Bounded native version-target checks and selected explicit-data direct/version reference coherence have executed fixtures. SQL supplements version-owned target coherence only.
constraints.unclaimed_or_deferred: SQL bindings do not replace native assessment subject/required-role admission; no full conditional multi-relation risk-record acceptance.

rows.proposed_text: The updated ORSD connects requirement families to concepts, constraints and current evidence. The public trace ledger accounts for 28 rows: 12 requirements, eight scope statements and eight CQ contracts; complete trace accounting does not mean complete acceptance. The five synthetic tasks in Table III correspond to CQ01–CQ05. Across all eight contracts, asserted-graph SPARQL execution with inference disabled matches 32 fixed-answer cases and detects eight query mutants, including missing and conflicting data controls. Numeric values, locators, interpretation origin, correction metadata and raw candidates are explicit application fields, not native OWL properties. In that baseline, CQ06–CQ08 have synthetic controls only and their original independently prepared populations remain NOT_RUN; five of eight original population contracts have bounded synthetic execution. Separate source-backed supplements now inspect 13 CQ06 statements and, for CQ07/CQ08, five original/reissued assertion pairs and 11 already-withheld documentary candidates. Their source queries and synthetic controls retain separate populations; they do not establish complete original case-population acceptance or independent stakeholder validation. The historical pre-public registry retains its separate provenance.
